findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.counterpart: No Bergstrom/Forsman 1973 entry appears on reference-list pp. 4605-4607.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The callout occurs in the HBV-96 expansion, while the supplied list contains Bergstrom records from 1994, 1995, and 2001 but none coauthored by Forsman in 1973.
findings.recommended_disposition: Ask the authors to supply the full 1973 record or remove/replace the callout; do not infer the missing metadata.

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.counterpart: No Van den Hurk-led 2005 entry appears on reference-list pp. 4605-4607.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The PRUDENCE sentence gives 2005; the available Hurk van den-led record is explicitly 2006 and is a different year identity.
findings.recommended_disposition: Request the full 2005 record or author-confirmed replacement/removal of the callout; do not collapse it into the 2006 record.

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.counterpart: No Jacob-led 2007 entry appears on reference-list pp. 4605-4607.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The discussion groups this callout with two Leander studies; the only listed record containing Jacob is Lorenz and Jacob (2008), not a Jacob-led 2007 work.
findings.recommended_disposition: Ask the authors for the full Jacob et al. 2007 record or removal/replacement of that atomic callout.

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.location: printed pp. 4604-4605, line 25 and opening lines (physical pp. 16-17)
findings.counterpart: No Leander-led 2005 entry appears on reference-list pp. 4605-4607.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The work is invoked twice for HBV flood-peak and inundation limitations; the list contains Leander records only for 2007 and 2008.
findings.recommended_disposition: Request the full 2005 record or author-confirmed replacement/removal, preserving both occurrence locations in the query.

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.location: reference list, printed p. 4607, opening lines (physical p. 19)
findings.observed_item: Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI): The HBV model, 2007
findings.counterpart: No formal SMHI 2007 author-date callout occurs before the reference list.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The methods text mentions the institute and says HBV was developed in the early 1970s, but it does not attach 2007 to that attribution.
findings.recommended_disposition: Ask whether a claim should receive an SMHI (2007) callout; otherwise remove the unused record. Do not turn the undated institution mention into a citation silently.

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.location: callout at printed p. 4591, lines 25-26; candidate entry at p. 4607 (physical pp. 3 and 19)
findings.counterpart: The only 2004 entry containing STOWA credits Smits, Wijngaarden, Versteeg, and Kok as authors and places STOWA later in the record.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The shared year and unique STOWA token make the Smits record a candidate, but the supplied manuscript does not establish that a publisher-like field may replace the credited author.
findings.recommended_disposition: Ask the authors to confirm the intended work and credited author; if the candidate is intended, change the callout to Smits et al. (2004), otherwise supply the intended STOWA-authored record.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4606 record has exactly two authors: Bergstrom and Carlsson.
findings.manuscript_evidence: Elsewhere the manuscript distinguishes named pairs from multi-author et al. forms; the work identity is otherwise established by first author and year.
findings.recommended_disposition: Replace the callout component Bergstrom et al., 1994 with Bergstrom and Carlsson, 1994 within the parenthetical group, retaining the manuscript's chosen accent convention.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4607 record has exactly two authors: Warmerdam and Wit de.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The author-year identity is unique, but et al. suppresses the second author of a two-author record.
findings.recommended_disposition: Change the callout component Warmerdam et al., 2001 to Warmerdam and de Wit, 2001 within the parenthetical group, using the manuscript's particle convention consistently.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4606 record has exactly two authors: Lorenz and Jacob.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The ENSEMBLES context and unique first-author/year link establish the record, leaving an author-cardinality error in the callout.
findings.recommended_disposition: Change the parenthetical callout to (Lorenz and Jacob, 2008).

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4606 record has exactly two authors: Leander and Buishand.
findings.manuscript_evidence: Multiple occurrences resolve to the same two-author 2007 record, whereas the listed 2008 Leander work has four authors.
findings.recommended_disposition: At each 2007 occurrence, use Leander and Buishand while preserving whether the source location is narrative or parenthetical; do not change correct 2008 et al. callouts.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4607 record for 2001a credits only M. J. M. de Wit.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The year suffix and unique title entry resolve identity; et al. invents additional authors. On p. 4604 the malformed item shares a group with the valid multi-author 2007b item.
findings.recommended_disposition: Use the single-author de Wit form with 2001a while preserving local citation grammar; on p. 4604 separate it from the retained de Wit et al. 2007b component.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The matching single-author record is labeled 2001a on p. 4607; no unsuffixed de Wit 2001 entry is listed.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The unique single-author record and matching climate-impact context establish the candidate without changing authorship.
findings.recommended_disposition: Change the narrative citation to De Wit (2001a).

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4607 low-flows record labeled 2007a has six authors.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The same page later uses De Wit et al. (2007a) for the same low-flow work, establishing the manuscript's own applicable form.
findings.recommended_disposition: Change the singular narrative form to De Wit et al. (2007a).

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4607 record labeled 2007b has three authors: de Wit, Buiteveld, and van Deursen.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The suffix uniquely identifies the listed record, but the narrative form omits two credited authors.
findings.recommended_disposition: Change the narrative citation to De Wit et al. (2007b).

findings.heading: Author decision required
findings.counterpart: No unsuffixed de Wit 2007 record is listed; p. 4607 instead has distinct 2007a and 2007b multi-author records.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The surrounding critical-low-flow claim points toward the 2007a low-flows title, but context alone does not prove the authors' intended source.
findings.recommended_disposition: Ask the authors to confirm the intended work; if 2007a is intended, change to De Wit et al. (2007a), otherwise supply the correct identity.

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4606 record for 2007 has two authors: Leander and Buishand.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The one-name narrative cannot correctly represent this two-author component, and the adjacent year resolves to a different author group.
findings.recommended_disposition: Split the compact citation and render this component as Leander and Buishand (2007).

findings.heading: Confirmed discrepancy
findings.counterpart: The p. 4606 record for 2008 has four authors: Leander, Buishand, van den Hurk, and de Wit.
findings.manuscript_evidence: The singular narrative omits coauthors, and the author list differs from the preceding 2007 component.
findings.recommended_disposition: Split the compact citation and render this component as Leander et al. (2008).
